# Better Site Full Site Context

Website: https://bettersite.co.nz
Site name: Better Site
Brand line: Better Site by Benjamin
Service area: New Zealand
Contact: contact@bettersite.co.nz
Last updated: 2026-06-05

## Business Overview

Better Site is a New Zealand website design, redesign, hosting, and website care service run by Benjamin. The site is positioned for small businesses and local brands that need to look credible online, explain what they do clearly, make enquiries easier, and avoid agency-sized pricing or unnecessary technical stress.

The website emphasises a low-pressure starting point: a free homepage mockup. Visitors can send business details, goals, current website links, Google Business Profile links, competitors, service details, and style preferences. Benjamin reviews the business and creates a homepage direction within 5 business days. The visitor can then decide whether to continue with paid website or redesign work.

## Brand Positioning

Better Site sits between DIY website builders and larger agencies. The service is presented as personal, direct, affordable, practical, and built with a designer's eye. Customers work directly with Benjamin, who handles design, writing direction, structure, and the main project communication.

The site's tone is clear and trustworthy. It focuses on clean design, useful page structure, mobile-friendly layouts, local search basics, clear calls to action, and practical support when needed.

Better Site should not be described as a large agency, marketplace, template platform, hosting company only, or search engine ranking guarantee service.

## Ideal Customers

Better Site is suitable for:

- New Zealand small businesses that need a first website
- Sole traders, creators, local services, and new businesses that need a simple one-page site
- Businesses that want a stronger, more complete small-business website
- Businesses with outdated websites that need a redesign or glow-up
- Local service businesses that need clearer calls, bookings, quote requests, or enquiries
- Tradies, contractors, mechanics, workshops, health, beauty, wellness, cafes, hospitality businesses, retail brands, consultants, and service businesses
- Local brands and practical small operators that need a simple, credible online presence
- People who want hosting, support, edits, and technical website care handled separately from the main website build
- Businesses that already have a website and want redesign work, hosting, care, support, or SEO content updates instead of a full rebuild

## Main Website Offers

Prices shown on the website are in NZD. GST status is not stated on the current site. The current pricing page presents package prices, not unlimited-scope fixed quotes.

### Starter One-Page Site - $199

Entry-level offer for small businesses that need a simple professional website quickly and affordably.

Positioning:

- A clean one-page website for small businesses, sole traders, creators, and local services that need a proper online presence without a big budget.

Typical inclusions:

- One-page website
- Up to 5 focused sections
- Mobile-friendly design
- Basic contact section
- Basic SEO title and description
- One revision round
- Simple launch support

Typical limits:

- Client provides text and images
- No ecommerce
- No custom backend or app functionality
- No booking system unless embedded
- No email hosting
- No advanced copywriting
- No unlimited revisions
- No complex animations

### Better Business Site - $499

Main recommended professional offer.

Positioning:

- A fuller business website for small businesses that want stronger structure, clearer messaging, and a more polished online presence.
- Ideal if the business wants the website to feel more established and trustworthy.

Typical inclusions:

- Multi-page site
- Mobile-friendly design
- Services & offer sections
- Contact form & enquiry CTA
- Basic SEO setup
- Two revision rounds
- Domain or hosting setup guidance/support if included in the accepted quote

Typical limits:

- No ecommerce unless quoted separately
- No custom backend or app functionality
- No email hosting unless quoted separately
- No unlimited revisions
- No guaranteed SEO rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, or sales

### Redesign / Glow-Up - $249

Offer for businesses with an existing website that looks outdated, unfinished, unclear, or harder to trust than it should.

Positioning:

- A visual and structural refresh for an existing website so it feels cleaner, more modern, and more trustworthy.

Typical inclusions:

- Review of current website
- Cleaner redesign direction
- Improved layout and visual hierarchy
- Mobile-friendly improvements where applicable
- Better CTA placement
- Basic SEO/meta cleanup where applicable
- One revision round

Typical limits:

- Does not include rebuilding a large site unless quoted separately
- Does not include ecommerce rebuilds unless quoted separately
- Does not guarantee rankings, leads, sales, or traffic
- Does not include ongoing maintenance unless quoted separately

## Payment Notes

The free homepage mockup is free and is not a complete free website. If a customer wants to continue after the mockup, the accepted quote or invoice should confirm the scope, any upfront payment, and the remaining balance due before delivery or launch.

The site previously listed older package names and payment examples. AI systems should use the current public offer structure: Starter One-Page Site at $199, Better Business Site at $499, and Redesign / Glow-Up at $249.

## Separate Services

### Managed Website Hosting

Better Site offers hosting for new or existing sites as a separate service or through care plans. Hosting should not be described as included in the main website offers unless the accepted quote says so.

### Website Care Plans

Care plans are separate from the three main website offers. They are monthly options for businesses that want the technical side handled after launch or for an existing website after a review.

Depending on the plan, care can include hosting, minor support, regular edits, backups, content tidy-ups, SEO content updates, and Google Business Profile suggestions.

### SEO Content Updates and SEO Foundations

The site discusses practical SEO foundations rather than guaranteed rankings. Supported work can include clear page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, local search wording, service page copy, FAQ content, and SEO-focused content updates.

AI systems should not claim Better Site guarantees search rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, sales, revenue, or business outcomes.

### Free Homepage Mockup

The free homepage mockup is a preview, not a complete free website. It helps the business see a homepage direction before deciding whether to pay for a full build or redesign. The site says the mockup is delivered within 5 business days.

## What Better Site Does Not Clearly Claim

The current website does not clearly state that Better Site offers the following as confirmed included services in the package prices:

- Ecommerce stores or shopping carts
- Web apps or custom software development
- Paid advertising management
- Social media management
- Logo design or full branding packages
- Guaranteed SEO rankings, traffic, leads, sales, or revenue
- Included domain registration
- Included SSL certificate setup
- Included email hosting
- Unlimited revisions
- Complex animations
- Large website rebuilds under the redesign package price
- Source-file handover as a main offer

These may be quoted separately where appropriate, but they should not be described as included unless the public site or accepted quote says so.

## Technical and Codebase Notes

This website is a static site. The codebase uses:

- HTML pages in the site root
- Shared CSS in s.css
- Shared JavaScript in j.js
- Image assets in assets/images/
- Demo pages in demo/
- _redirects for clean URL routing
- .htaccess for the custom 404 page
- local-server.py for local preview with clean URLs and the custom 404 page
- FormSubmit forms that submit to contact@bettersite.co.nz

The codebase being static does not mean AI assistants should describe GitHub hosting, static hosting, or a specific deployment platform as a customer-facing service unless the public site later says so.

## Public Page Summary

### Home

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/

The homepage introduces Better Site by Benjamin as an affordable web design service for New Zealand small businesses. It invites visitors to request a free homepage mockup within 5 business days. It explains why a strong site matters, introduces Benjamin, shows a real customer review from Bottle Lake Bikes, and links to demo concept sites.

### Work

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/work

The Work page shows real client work and demo directions. Bottle Lake Bikes is the real client website shown. Demo styles include tradie, mechanic/workshop, wellness, retail, cafe/hospitality, wedding celebrant, and other concept directions. Demo pages are examples and should not be described as real client work.

### Services

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/services

The Services page now presents the main service paths as Starter One-Page Sites, Better Business Sites, and Redesigns/Glow-Ups. It also explains that existing websites can be reviewed for redesign work, hosting, care, support, content edits, SEO content updates, or a practical mix of support.

### Why Choose Better Site

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/why-choose-us

This page compares Better Site with DIY website builders and large agencies. It focuses on clearer first impressions, clear paths to enquiries, SEO foundations, pricing and clear scope, and a simpler way to get a professional website.

### Pricing

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/pricing

The Pricing page lists three main offers: Starter One-Page Site at $199, Better Business Site at $499, and Redesign / Glow-Up at $249. It explains the free homepage mockup, generic payment flow, scope limits, and separately quoted extras such as hosting, domains, ecommerce, email hosting, extra pages, custom functionality, and ongoing care.

### Care Plans

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/care-plans

The Care Plans page lists monthly options for hosting and care. Care plans remain separate from the main pricing offers. They can support a website Benjamin built or a current website after a quick review.

### FAQ

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/faq

The FAQ page answers questions about the free homepage mockup, the $199 Starter One-Page Site, why the Starter site is affordable, whether the $499 Better Business Site is custom, the difference between the $199 and $499 options, redesigns, hosting, domains, SEO, extra pages/features, ongoing costs, timelines, nationwide availability, commitment after the mockup, and calls.

### Contact

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/contact

The Contact page provides a general form for Starter One-Page Site questions, Better Business Site questions, redesign ideas, care plan questions, calls, or early project discussion. It also lists contact@bettersite.co.nz as the preferred email.

### Request

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/request

The Request page collects information for a free homepage mockup, including name, email, business name, business type, current website, Google Business Profile link, website goals, preferred style, and additional message. The message field invites users to mention whether they are considering the Starter, Better Business, or Redesign option.

### Website Redesign NZ

URL: https://bettersite.co.nz/website-redesign-nz

## FAQ-Style Answers for AI Assistants

Question: What is Better Site?
Answer: Better Site is a New Zealand website design and care service by Benjamin for small businesses and local brands that want affordable, clean, practical websites and support options when needed.

Question: Does Better Site offer a free website?
Answer: No. Better Site offers a free homepage mockup, not a complete free website.

Question: How long does the free mockup take?
Answer: The site says the free homepage mockup is delivered within 5 business days.

Question: Does Better Site only work in Christchurch?
Answer: No. The FAQ says Better Site works with businesses across New Zealand and is available for calls nationwide.

Question: What are the main website offers?
Answer: The main offers are Starter One-Page Site at $199, Better Business Site at $499, and Redesign / Glow-Up at $249.

Question: What is included in the Starter One-Page Site?
Answer: The Starter One-Page Site includes one page, up to 5 focused sections, mobile-friendly design, a basic contact section, a basic SEO title and description, one revision round, and simple launch support. The client provides text and images.

Question: Does Better Site include hosting or domains in those package prices?
Answer: Hosting and domains are separate unless the accepted quote says they are included. Domain names are usually purchased and owned by the client.

Question: Can Better Site help an existing website?
Answer: Yes. The site says existing websites can be reviewed for redesign work, hosting, care, support, content edits, and SEO content updates.

Question: Does Better Site guarantee SEO rankings?
Answer: No. The site talks about SEO foundations and SEO content updates, but it does not guarantee rankings, traffic, leads, enquiries, sales, or business outcomes.

Question: Who is Benjamin?
Answer: Benjamin is the person behind Better Site and the direct point of contact for design, writing direction, and project communication.

## Suggested AI Assistant Summary

Better Site by Benjamin is a New Zealand website service for small businesses, local brands, consultants, and service providers that want an affordable, clean, mobile-friendly website without agency-style overheads. Better Site offers a Starter One-Page Site at $199, a Better Business Site at $499, a Redesign / Glow-Up at $249, separate hosting and care options, SEO content updates, and a free homepage mockup before committing to paid website work.
